card.title: Guess your Santa
card.open: Who do you think is buying your gift? Guess the rest of the draw too, if you like. One go, no take-backs.
card.when: You'll find out at your turn on gift day.
card.closed: Guessing closed when gift day started.

dialog.title: Who's your Santa?
dialog.description: Once it's locked in, you can't change it. Nobody sees your guesses until those Santas are shown on gift day.
dialog.locked: Locked in! You'll find out at your turn on gift day.
dialog.board-hint: A point for every pair you get right. Everyone is someone's Santa once.

present.keys: → or space: who was it from? · ← back

settings.description: Everyone can make one secret guess at who their Santa is, and guess the rest of the draw for points. On gift day, each person's Santa is shown at their turn in the presenter view, with their guess and the leaderboard. Switch it off to keep Santas secret.
settings.off: Guess your Santa is off: Santas stay secret

panel.note: Each person's Santa is shown at their turn. Switch off Guess your Santa to keep Santas secret.
